name: app_dir
title: Record app information in a convenient object

origin.usage: app_dir(appname = NULL, appauthor = appname, version = NULL, expand = TRUE, os = NULL)

arguments.name: appname
arguments.text: is the name of application. If NULL, just the system directory is returned.

arguments.name: appauthor
arguments.text: (only required and used on Windows) is the name of the appauthor or distributing body for this application. Typically it is the owning company name. This falls back to appname.

arguments.name: version
arguments.text: is an optional version path element to append to the path. You might want to use this if you want multiple versions of your app to be able to run independently. If used, this would typically be "<major>.<minor>". Only applied when appname is not NULL.

arguments.name: expand
arguments.text: If TRUE (the default) will expand the R_LIBS specifiers with their equivalents. See R_LIBS() for list of all possibly specifiers.

arguments.name: os
arguments.text: Operating system whose conventions are used to construct the requested directory. Possible values are "win", "mac", "unix". If NULL (the default) then the current OS will be used.

origin.details: Each method forwards the stored appname, appauthor, version, expand, and os to the corresponding user_* or site_* directory function.
origin.value: A list with callable elements cache, log, data, config, site_data, site_config, and a character os field.
origin.example:
ggplot2_app <- app_dir("ggplot2", "hadley")
ggplot2_app$cache()
ggplot2_app$log()
ggplot2_app$data()
ggplot2_app$config()
ggplot2_app$site_config()
ggplot2_app$site_data()

translation.description: Return an AppDir object whose methods build the same paths as the rappdirs directory helpers for one application.

arguments.name: appname
arguments.text: Application name passed to every path method. None returns only the system directory from each method.

arguments.name: appauthor
arguments.text: Windows author directory. Omitted, it uses appname.

arguments.name: version
arguments.text: Optional path segment. expand rewrites R_LIBS specifiers when true.

arguments.name: expand
arguments.text: When true, version specifiers are expanded like R_LIBS before paths are built.

arguments.name: os
arguments.text: win, mac, or unix. None uses this process operating system.

translation.details: Methods mirror the R closures: cache and log take opinion; data and config take roaming defaulting to false; site_data and site_config take multipath defaulting to false. cache() calls the translated user_cache_dir; the other methods use the same path rules as rappdirs 0.3.4 in this module.
translation.value: An AppDir instance with cache, log, data, config, site_data, site_config methods and an os attribute.
translation.example:
from rappdirs.appdir import app_dir

ggplot2_app = app_dir("ggplot2", "hadley")
print(ggplot2_app.cache())
print(ggplot2_app.log())
print(ggplot2_app.data())
print(ggplot2_app.config())
print(ggplot2_app.site_config())
print(ggplot2_app.site_data())
